decisions.reason: As a newly launched mechanical water-control product that is still shown on the website, it likely fits the firm's core engineering business and would usually be given more time to build sales.

The energy management system matches growing efficiency needs in water facilities, but as a newer systems-oriented offer it carries somewhat higher commercialization risk than the firm's more traditional equipment.
A dedicated product page suggests stronger commercial commitment, and an overflow flap gate is a clear fit with an established German machinery firm's durable industrial product portfolio.
